question: What information, reporting and visibility does the business need to run itself and improve?

needs.need: The business needs to provide real-time operational dashboards that visualize key performance indicators (KPIs) such as order fulfillment times, delivery agent utilization rates, and store partner quality scores to enabl...
needs.why: Without live visibility into these metrics, the business cannot proactively manage SLA compliance, optimize dynamic routing, or address bottlenecks in the hyperlocal delivery network before they impact customer satisfaction.

needs.need: The business needs to generate comprehensive financial reconciliation reports that compare platform revenue shares against actual store settlements and transaction fees to ensure accurate cost control and margin analysis...
needs.why: Given the complexity of multi-party financial flows involving commissions, delivery fees, and subscriptions, automated reconciliation is essential to prevent revenue leakage and maintain trust with store partners.

needs.need: The business needs to produce predictive analytics reports on demand patterns and inventory turnover to optimize resource allocation and reduce overselling incidents.
needs.why: In a model dependent on real-time inventory synchronization and ultra-fast delivery, forward-looking insights are critical for balancing supply with fluctuating demand and minimizing operational waste.
